claims.text: External knowledge can be harnessed through text, graph, and text-and-graph based models to address the natural language inference problem in the science questions domain.

evidence.description: The authors present techniques combining external knowledge across text, graph, and text-and-graph based models evaluated on the SciTail dataset.

methodologies.name: External knowledge integration for NLI
methodologies.description: Techniques harnessing external structured knowledge from open knowledge bases across text, graph, and hybrid text-and-graph models.

limitations.text: Existing approaches to NLI focus largely on learning-based methods using only textual information and do not well explore structured external knowledge bases.
